ns2:course.label: Elementary Japanese I
ns2:course.description: Introduction to Japanese, spoken language skills and the reading and writing of hirigana, katakana, and kanji.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Freshmen, Sophomore or Junior status. Note: Japanese 201 is for those with no Japanese background. Students who have Japanese background or who have previously taken a course(s) in Japanese must take the Japanese Placement test.
